evidence.observation: P 3.00 Torr at growth start, same as the ~2.97 Torr held through the ramp
P rose steadily 3.00 to 3.10, 3.15, 3.24 and 3.34 Torr over 480 s of growth
Ar steady at ~100 sccm, so more gas flowing in does not explain the pressure rise
T holding 750 °C, heater power ~45%, both look normal
O2 sensor not installed, so air getting in cannot be checked, and growth requires this sensor

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or a test such as a pump-down/rate-of-rise leak check or checking the exhaust line or valve, would show whether this is a seal leak or an exhaust blockage.
